forbidden_commands: Any command that prints, logs, or saves a token
tss startup on or off without TSS_HOME
Direct app execution without both TSS_HOME and TSS_SKILLS_DIR pointing at disposable folders
Any command that accesses the real skills, settings, or work folders
Any command that writes Windows' Run or StartupApproved\Run keys
Pushing to fixture main branches or running live scripts against repositories not owned by the user
scripts\dev.ps1 clean while another worktree or live run is active
install_policy: Cargo is the package manager; preserve Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock. Do not install tools during feature runs. Restore missing dependencies with cargo fetch --locked only after a check fails because dependencies are missing; this may use the network but must not change the manifests or lockfile. New or upgraded dependencies and tool installs need separate approval; a new runtime dependency also needs a measured reason. No npm setup.
